sources.detail: All 6 registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 196-343 KB decompressed (r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted - IP-403 on this host; sizes read off disk because curl's size_download reports the COMPRESSED length). <style> blocks stripped BEFORE parsing since the tier-list CSS ships inline, and <table class="tier-list"> asserted at EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Counts reconciled BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40 and M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. 2 letters moved, BOTH on the raid HEALER page and a straight swap at the top of it: Holy Priest A -> S and Holy Paladin S -> A. That page now self-dates 2026-09-01 (JSON-LD dateModified plus an in-body 'LAST UPDATED - 01st of September' and a new changelog row 'Updated for the end of RWF Mythic progression') where last night recorded 2026-08-24, so published was corrected to what the page says today rather than carried forward: raid 08-30 / 09-01 / 08-08, M+ 08-30 / 08-30 / 08-30. Era: every page's body and changelog self-identify as Season 2 and Devourer is present in the DPS lists; the raid-healer page's TITLE still reads '(Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight)' and is overridden by the body per the blue-tracker precedent, and the Season-1 hits are changelog rows and retrospective prose, not the ranking body. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run.

Both registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 160 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 167 KB decompressed. Parsed from the tier__title / data-original-title markup and resolved by ROSTER MATCH rather than container position, which is again what rejects the M+ page's second tierlist: its eight entries are dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale) and none maps to a spec. Counts reconciled before merging: raid 40 unique of 40, M+ 40 unique of 40, 0 unmatched. ZERO letters moved in either bracket. The pages' own 'Last Updated' lines are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+), which is the honest explanation for a static parse; the snapshot advances because we fetched today, the page dates do not. Era: both self-identify as Midnight Season 2, no Season 1 string anywhere, Devourer present. seasonVerified stays s2.

All 6 registered pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 75-340 KB decompressed; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse per the recorded recipe: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then find the [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] block (never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml - the raid-healer page carries a decoy call), segment on [tier-label ...]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug against the roster. Exactly one tier-list block per page. Counts reconciled before merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched slugs, 0 duplicate-tier conflicts, all letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. ZERO letters moved - and every page's dateModified is unchanged from last night (raid 08-31 x3; M+ 08-28 / 08-26 / 09-01), so a static parse is exactly what a static page should produce rather than a silent parser failure. The raid DPS list currently has no S tier at all; that is upstream's shape, verified against the parsed block, not a dropped tier. published re-read per page and written unchanged. Era: all six self-identify as Midnight Season 2 and Devourer is present in both DPS lists. seasonVerified stays s2.

The payload was DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest, and the result is the mirror image of last night: 0 of 40 lowerBound values moved and 0 of 40 numberOfCharacters moved. The 22:23 rewrite carries the same numbers merged last night; what actually changed is that the manifest caught up to them. So this merge is a DATE correction, not new numbers - asOf moves 2026-08-11 -> 2026-09-01 because that is what the source now says its snapshot is. Selection as specified: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined = 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged excluded as dps subsets), merged at 1 dp to match stored precision with n from numberOfCharacters. The owner-accepted standing red should now clear on the age gate as this date ages in.

MERGED 40 rows - upstream re-cut for the first time since 2026-08-28. Plain browser-UA GET on all three meta pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB. Rows split on '<a [^>]*class="vi-box meta-item' per the 2026-08-31 attribute-order trap, and counts reconciled at 27 DPS / 7 healer / 6 tank = 40 with 0 unmatched before any merge decision. Each page's own <time datetime> now reads 2026-09-02T10:10Z (08-28T03:00Z for four straight nights before this). All 40 values moved and every one moved UP, by 2.7% to 7.0% with a median of about 4.2% - the shape of top-50 rating ceilings climbing through a season rather than a re-scale or a column swap; largest Augmentation Evoker 2857 -> 3058, smallest Marksmanship Hunter 3315 -> 3406. Well inside maxValueMovePct 0.6 and maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35. asOf is the SOURCE's own <time> date 2026-09-02, not today, and the ordering is unchanged at the top (Blood DK still leads tanks, Holy Paladin and Resto Shaman still lead healers).

HELD WHOLESALE for a ninth night - a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure, and the blocking gate has narrowed to ONE. All 27 DPS charts requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 3 retries each: 23 return real payloads, every one carrying simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded) at chart timestamps 2026-09-02 / 09-03; 4 still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry - Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker. Retribution Paladin, in that error set for the last eight nights, is BACK. Against the 26 stored MID1 profiles (2026-07-08 / 07-15), wholesale adoption of the 23 would drop 26 -> 23 rows = 11.5%, comfortably inside maxRowDropPct 0.25, so the row floor no longer blocks adoption. What does: 121 of the 138 overlapping target rows move more than 60% (MID2/MID1 ratio min 1.152, median 1.908, max 2.872), tripping maxValueMovePct 0.6, and that gate has no agent-writable proposal channel - only a human value_move_ack re-run or a reviewed local run can land it. The tier-uniformity invariant separately forbids a pool holding both MID1 and MID2, and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key. Nothing merged; fightProfile.asOf stays each chart's OWN timestamp, so the coverage date correctly does not move and the staleness red is the honest signal.

HELD for a ninth night; the blocker is maxValueMovePct alone. MID2_Raid.txt is 1.36 MB, Last-Modified 2026-09-03T07:30:19Z, header '12.1.0.69587 Live (hotfix 2026-09-02/69587, git build HEAD f5b50a3f97)' - a NEW build hash (adc39a57a2 last night), so upstream is re-simming daily rather than frozen. Its 'DPS Ranking:' block holds 43 profiles which map by longest-prefix (hyphen allowed) to 23 of 27 DPS specs; absent are Balance, Feral, Augmentation and Devastation - the same four Bloodmallet is missing, which is why these two rows keep clearing together. MID1_Raid.txt is again 272 BYTES (Last-Modified 2026-09-03T07:07:34Z), an in-progress run with no ranking block, and carries the SAME build header as MID2 - so MID1 is neither the 12.0.7 artefact the contract label describes nor usable as a fallback. Wholesale adoption would drop 26 -> 23 stored rows = 11.5%, inside maxRowDropPct, but all 23 overlap rows move more than 60% (77.6% to 135.2%; Fury Warrior 109,256 -> 256,921), so the value gate fires and needs the human value_move_ack. Nothing merged; the stored 26 rows and their 2026-08-08 date are byte-identical.

MERGED 40 rows at a NEW weekly period. /period/latest HTTP 200, 215 KB, now 302-resolving to period 1079 (against 1078 for the last several nights): 'Period 1079, week 3 of MID2 (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile) - Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (5350 unique), 16.6 average key level', and the page states the period just started and is still in progress. Parse bounded to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section (scanning the whole page picks up the Classes-and-specs block and the per-dungeon sections and yields ~59 rows), labels normalised on [-\s]+ with whitespace-tolerant number matching: 40 rows, 0 unmatched - Fire Mage is back upstream, so this is the first full 40-spec cut in days. Sanity-checked BEFORE merging: series sum 99.9 with role subtotals DPS 59.8 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.1, i.e. the representation share and not the /meta per-key-presence column (that one measures 7-10x higher with many exact zeros). 37 of 40 values moved, which is a period reset rather than drift - largest Arms Warrior 12.2 -> 9.9, Outlaw Rogue 2.9 -> 1.1, Protection Paladin 2.0 -> 3.3, Havoc 0.5 -> 1.4; all values are under minValueMagnitude 100 so the value-move gate does not apply. Merged at asOf 2026-09-03.

ONE new feed entry, read from the canonical Blizzard source rather than the Wowhead mirror: 2026-09-02, kind 'hotfix' - Kaivax's running hotfix blue post (us.forums topic 2336376, title now 'World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - September 2', post 1 at version 27, updated 2026-09-03T01:11:28Z), read with its <ul> heading structure INTACT. Three class lines, all bug fixes with no tuning value: Druid > Feral (Unseen Predator Rank 1 now prefers targets not immune to damage or taking under 5% physical damage) and Warlock > Destruction (Font of Venomous Rage channel could be cancelled if spell-queued after Cataclysm) sit under explicit SPEC headings; the Bladestorm nameplate line sits under a BARE Warrior heading with no spec block beneath it and is logged class-wide rather than guessed onto Arms or Fury (the 2026-08-26 Warrior precedent). All three classify null under classifyHighlight - checked with the function, not assumed - so this round-up casts no outlook vote. NO LINE TOUCHES A SET BONUS, so no spec.tierSet date moves and the tier-set upkeep gate stays quiet. The entire Player versus Player section triages out (Balance Druid's Faerie Swarm raid-frame debuff, the Evoker PvP-vendor staff fix, Preservation's Rewind-under-Cyclone fix). Non-class content folded into the entry's summary line: Mythic Ula'tek phase-two nerfs (Soul Constrictor duration to 5s, Blight Vein damage -25%), two Doomscale Egg pickup fixes and two Catalyst repairs. Recorded for the record: the Wowhead mirror renders the Warrior line as 'Bladetorm'; the blue post reads Bladestorm, and that is what is logged. Lanes also polled and empty of anything else - Wowhead news RSS HTTP 200, 40 items 2026-08-30T13:00Z to 2026-09-03T14:00Z; the news INDEX (data.news.newsData, 20 posts) topping out at the same id as RSS; the blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries, 50 unique topics) carrying no standalone class post, with Linxy's 'Week 3 of 3: Interrupts and dispels' turning out to be a player thread with a blue reply; and the dev-notes thread 2317811 at 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42Z, correctly quiet for a closed cycle. NO 12.2 PTR ANNOUNCEMENT anywhere, so PHASES.ptr stays null and the zone 54/52/56/57 lanes stayed dormant per the between-cycles posture - not fetched and deliberately not recorded as unreachable, since their contract rows left at the flip. Wowhead's 'Season 2 DPS Rankings for The Venomous Abyss: Week 2' (news=382699) is its own writers' analysis, not a Blizzard post and not a registered tier list, so it is deliberately not a feed entry.

All 44 transcribable channels with a channelId polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos, media:description parsed alongside each title. Seen-set recomputed from the four structured lanes (videos[]/skipped[]/seen[] plus every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url) = 1225 ids; 275 unseen, all 275 inside the cycle (bound 2026-06-18, the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and not an index). This is a nightly, so the keyword filter governs QUEUEING: 168 of the 275 are keyword-relevant and everything not queued is left in NO lane as a budget dismissal so a local run reconsiders it. transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict 'ok', requested 3 / fetched 3, all three read in full. Distilled 10 metaNotes and 5 takes. (1) izen nuUVv1WwfLM (2026-08-31), general-creator metaNotes lane, raid: his Before-and-After recap scoring the channel's pre-season raid predictions against live parses - Devourer DH negative (tested and simmed well, now bottom half and arguably the worst caster in the game, cause attributed to the season-start tier-set cut), Frost DK negative (his single worst prediction-vs-reality gap), Windwalker negative (squishiest DPS alongside Balance, no full raid buff to lean on), Havoc mixed (taking Devourer's slot on MOVEMENT, not damage - both 'midling to average'), Marksmanship positive (burst niche, double-MM in the race, with his own ceiling caveat), Subtlety/Assassination/Outlaw positive (post-testing buffs nobody got to test; Outlaw's note carries his own caveat that its Zorak first place rests on ONE logged parse), Balance positive, Arms positive. Each superseded izen's prior RAID-lens metaNote for that spec, 10 in all; his M+ and unbracketed notes are a different lens and stay live. Deliberately NOT distilled from it: the bare enumeration of top Mythic results is a list-mention, the Vengeance passage is explicitly hypothetical, and Fire/Frost Mage appear only inside enumerations. (2) Dalaran Gaming acRd5yk-3N0 (2026-08-29) -> 3 takes on the September 1 PvE pass, in-scope only: Feral Druid (buff, raid - he says Feral's raid value has fallen drastically and splits the pass by where it lands), Beast Mastery Hunter (buff, both - the 7% covers pet AND abilities) and Survival Hunter (buff, both - stated intent to pull SV and BM up to Marksmanship, hedged on magnitude). Superseded his general-lens 2026-06-25 BM and Survival takes; the raid-scoped Feral take does not retire his general 06-30 one. His Frost DK, Demon Hunter, Protection Paladin and Discipline Priest passages fall outside his registered classes and were NOT distilled, and his thin Arcane line was deliberately not minted because it would have displaced his richer live 08-24 Arcane take for nothing. (3) Critcake S2nGA4gww8I (2026-08-29) -> 2 M+ takes, Arms and Fury, both neutral: with the new four-piece finally equipped he reads the two as very close in keys, Arms doing more priority damage and Fury very similar overalls, and says spec choice is preference - a parity read he genuinely expressed, not a placeholder. It supersedes his 2026-08-26 Fury M+ take, which had deferred exactly this comparison until the four-piece landed, and the two 2026-07-09 Arms M+ takes. Queued 3 keyword-relevant videos with no fetched transcript: izen 4z49EhVeP7I (2026-09-01, the M+ counterpart to tonight's raid recap), MadSkillzzTV yD9mjG-ajUU (2026-09-01, healer balance across M+ and raid - the thin lane) and Dalaran Gaming Kq3saXcBt10 (2026-09-02, the 'PATCH 12.1.5 LEAKED? MAYBE NEW PTR LATER?' stream, a ptr-watch LEAD to verify against the canonical thread, never a source).
